resources.string:
Android blocks apps from reading the clipboard in the background. clipsync uses Shizuku — a separate open-source app you start once per boot — to read the clipboard with the same privilege the system shell has.

What it reads: the clipboard, when its content changes.
What it never does: read your screen, log keystrokes, or collect analytics.
Where your data goes: only to your own paired devices, end-to-end encrypted. There is no server.
